boot
====

.. tip:: Ingestion into Splunk.

   **``linux:boot``**

   * name_rex: ``boot.*\.jsonl$``
   * sourcetype: ``linux:boot``
   * host_rex: ``([\w\.-]+?)--``
   * artifact: ``boot``

Description
-----------

Parsing logs from '/var/log/boot'
